mapper.select: select (select count(1) from spider_definition) as spiderTotalCount, (select count(1) from spider_execution where spider_execution_status = 'RUNNING') as spiderRunningCount, (select count(1) from spider_url_queue) as spiderUrlCount, (select count(1) from spider_url_queue where spider_parse_status = 'SUCCESS') as spiderParsedUrlCount, (select count(1) from spider_parse_result) as spiderResultCount, (select count(1) from spider_url_queue where spider_parse_status in ('WAITING', 'RUNNING')) as spiderRemainingUrlCount

select d.spider_site_host as siteHost, count(distinct q.spider_id) as spiderUrlCount, count(distinct r.spider_id) as spiderResultCount, sum(case when d.spider_status = 1 then 1 else 0 end) as spiderRunningCount, sum(case when d.spider_status = 1 then 0 else 1 end) as spiderWarningCount from spider_definition d left join spider_url_queue q on q.spider_definition_code = d.spider_code left join spider_parse_result r on r.spider_definition_code = d.spider_code group by d.spider_site_host order by spiderResultCount desc, spiderUrlCount desc

select date_format(spider_create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') as timeLabel, count(1) as count from spider_parse_result where spider_execution_no = #{executionNo} and spider_create_time >= date_sub(now(), interval 1 hour) group by date_format(spider_create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') order by date_format(spider_create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') asc

select date_format(source.spider_date, '%m-%d') as spiderDateLabel, sum(source.spider_parse_count) as spiderParseCount, sum(source.spider_result_count) as spiderResultCount from ( select date(spider_create_time) as spider_date, count(1) as spider_parse_count, 0 as spider_result_count from spider_url_queue where spider_create_time >= date_sub(curdate(), interval 6 day) group by date(spider_create_time)
union all
select date(spider_create_time) as spider_date, 0 as spider_parse_count, count(1) as spider_result_count from spider_parse_result where spider_create_time >= date_sub(curdate(), interval 6 day) group by date(spider_create_time) ) source group by source.spider_date order by source.spider_date asc
